title: Icarus
dek: A frightened arrival whose chicken disguise lets him survive a Rahu search party.

facts.Recorded at: The Gate and road to Pristinia

sources: Gate chronicle · selected arrival and welcome scenes; January 2024–September 2026 posting records
body:
The wrong moment to arrive

Icarus arrives at the Gate while Rahu patrols are a threat. Aravil reaches him first and warns him to hide. Four armed figures search the clearing, expecting an adventurer.

Overlooked in plain sight

Icarus takes the form of an ordinary chicken. The searchers notice the bird but overlook it, find no adventurer and withdraw after roughly half an hour. Aravil remains hidden until they leave. The scene ends without a battle between the two and the patrol.

Finding the first safe road

Once the soldiers leave, Icarus demands an explanation, then asks where he is and why he was brought here. He says he was expelled from his home after standing against an oppressor. Aravil offers her understanding of the war and leads him toward Pristinia. Her claims about the impossibility of returning home remain her knowledge, not a demonstrated universal rule.
